title: Oregon Christmas Tree Harvest With Helicopter.  Amazing Pilot!
summary: A short clip of a helicopter pilot harvesting Christmas trees at an Oregon farm with a sling load. The description adds facts about Oregon's Christmas tree industry.
why: HN cites it as an example of the skill of sling-load helicopter pilots.

quote.text: I am amazed as the skill and dexterity that they can handle their flying machines and use physics to best effect.
